scope: Three cold first-document exchanges per site; both directions, each complete encoded body subtracted.

limits: Python/OpenSSL representative request profile, not browser loads; fresh TLS context, no resumption or browser cache.
IPv4/TCP metadata on br0; offloaded segmentation estimated at a 1,500-byte MTU. Packet capture stops after client close and a 250 ms grace; idle window 80 ms.
Zero socket drops and SYN visibility are necessary checks, not proof of complete link visibility or no other capture loss.
TLS totals stop at first-document completion; packet totals include close. Their difference does not isolate TCP overhead.
DNS counts three explicit A/AAAA/HTTPS queries to the selected resolver, excluding OS address-lookup and recursive upstream traffic.
No peer HTML, addresses, ports, sequence numbers, arbitrary headers, cookies, packet payloads or secrets are published.
Complete encoded-body subtraction does not remove framing effects of body length; three samples do not establish a timing or universal ranking.
Runtime/client readbacks bracket the window as snapshots, not continuous monitoring. Historical September 22 evidence remains separate.
Each rawReportCompletedAt timestamps the completed six-site report, not a separately captured completion time for each request.
